questions.stem: What does the Dwarf racial Artisan's Precision give in Forever?
questions.explanation: Artisan's Precision gives +1% hit with spells and attacks. +1% crit is Human Ruthless and +2% haste is Skyborne Wind-Blessed.

questions.stem: Which new Alliance race and class combination lets Alliance raids plan around Shaman totems?
questions.explanation: Dwarf Shaman brings Shaman totems to Alliance raids. Human Hunter and Gnome Priest are the other new Alliance combinations, but neither brings totems.

questions.stem: Your raid leader wants a Dwarf Priest because the raid needs Fear Ward. At what level does every Priest, of any race, learn Fear Ward in Forever?
questions.explanation: Every Priest learns Fear Ward and Devouring Plague at 20, so any Priest can cover Fear Ward. Level 30 is Divine Spirit and level 32 is Shadow Word: Death.

questions.stem: Which racial spells does a Dwarf Priest unlock through class quests?
questions.explanation: Warcraft Tavern lists Desperate Prayer and Chastise for Dwarves. Divine Grace and Feedback are Human, Starshards and Elune's Grace Night Elf.

questions.stem: Where does the Dwarf Shaman's level 4 Earth totem quest start?
questions.explanation: Teo Hammerstorm's Earth totem quest starts in Anvilmar, Dun Morogh. The Water totem chain starts in Loch Modan and the Air totem quest takes you to Arathi Highlands.

questions.stem: Which Dwarf Shaman totem quest is the longest chain, at about 2 hours?
questions.explanation: Norric Lochthane's level 20 Water totem chain runs about 2 hours through Wetlands, Redridge, Ashenvale and Westfall. The Air totem quest is a short trip to Arathi Highlands.

questions.stem: Where does a Dwarf Warrior's main-hand hit come from in Forever?
questions.explanation: Furious Precision is the only Warrior talent that adds hit, and it covers off-hand attacks only. Main-hand hit comes from gear or Artisan's Precision.

questions.stem: In Classic 1.12, how much spell hit did casters need against raid bosses three levels higher?
questions.explanation: Classic casters needed 16% against raid bosses three levels higher. 1% is what Artisan's Precision adds. Forever's cap is not known yet.

questions.stem: Which totem can't be active at the same time as Windfury Totem?
questions.explanation: Windfury and Flametongue Totems can't both be active. Grace of Air no longer conflicts with either since 16 October.
